hero_prompt: Classical woodcut print on paper, bold black carved lines on warm cream, visible wood-grain and ink texture, flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a single plain, unornamented iron hand press standing alone in a quiet workshop with bare plank walls and one high window of light, its heavy platen lowered and its long lever pulled home; the press drawn with exact, careful symmetry, every edge square and true.
icon_prompt: A bold, high-contrast emblem of a single stamped type block — a thick black rectangle with one raised square boss at its center like cast lead type — rendered as a stark woodcut silhouette, no fine linework, reading clearly as a small mark.
